edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff's First Requests for Production based on information reasonably available after a diligent inquiry. These responses are made without waiver of, and subject to, all applicable objections, privileges, protections, and limitations under the applicable rules of civil procedure and evidence. Defendant's investigation and document collection remain ongoing, and Defendant reserves the right to amend or supplement these responses as appropriate.
edits.name: Revised Preliminary Statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it: (a) seeks information or documents protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, common-interest doctrine, or any other applicable privilege or protection; (b) is overbroad, unduly burdensome, disproportionate to the needs of the case, or not reasonably limited in time, scope, subject matter, or custodians; (c) seeks documents not within Defendant's possession, custody, or control; (d) seeks documents already in Plaintiff's possession or equally available to Plaintiff; (e) seeks confidential, proprietary, trade secret, private, or sensitive information absent an appropriate protective order or confidentiality safeguards; or (f) calls for legal conclusions or imposes obligations beyond those required by the applicable rules. Defendant's production of documents, if any, shall not constitute an admission that any document is relevant, admissible, authentic, or responsive, and Defendant expressly reserves all objections at trial or any hearing.
edits.name: Revised General Objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control that are located after a reasonable search and are proportional to the needs of the case. Defendant will produce documents on a rolling basis or at a mutually agreed time and in a reasonably usable form, subject to any applicable protective order, confidentiality agreement, ESI protocol, or other agreement of the parties.
edits.name: Revised Production Statement

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds otherwise responsive documents on the basis of privilege or protection, Defendant will identify such documents on a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules and any agreement or order governing privilege logs. Defendant reserves the right to withhold from any log categories of privileged materials not required to be logged, including attorney-client communications or attorney work product created after commencement of this action, to the extent permitted by rule, order, or agreement.
edits.name: Revised Privilege Log Statement

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to supplement, amend, revise, or correct these responses and objections as additional information becomes available or as required by applicable rules. Defendant further reserves all rights and objections regarding relevance, admissibility, authenticity, foundation, confidentiality, privilege, burden, proportionality, and the scope of discovery.
edits.name: Revised Reservation of Rights

edits.text: 1. OBJECTIONS. Defendant does not rely on any general objection to limit the scope of its responses unless the objection is expressly stated in response to a specific request. Any objection asserted in response to a specific request will identify the grounds for the objection with reasonable particularity and will state whether responsive materials are being withheld on the basis of that objection. Defendant preserves all applicable privileges and protections, including the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, common-interest doctrine, and any other applicable privilege or protection, and will withhold privileged or protected materials only as permitted by the applicable rules. Defendant further preserves objections, where specifically asserted, based on overbreadth, undue burden, proportionality, possession, custody or control, confidentiality, privacy, relevance, and admissibility. edits.name: Replace general objections with rule-compliant objections language

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. For each request as to which production is agreed, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control located after a reasonable search, subject to any specific limitations or objections stated in response to that request. Defendant will identify the custodians, repositories, date ranges, search methodology, or other scope limitations used for production where appropriate. Defendant will produce documents on a rolling basis and in a reasonably usable form. Defendant will not delay production of otherwise due, non-privileged responsive documents solely because a protective order, confidentiality agreement, or ESI protocol has not yet been entered or agreed, but Defendant reserves the right to designate confidential materials, seek appropriate confidentiality protections, and confer regarding ESI format, metadata, search terms, custodians, deduplication, and related production logistics.

The log will identify the nature of the withheld documents or communications in a manner that, without revealing privileged or protected information, will enable Plaintiff to assess the claim of privilege or protection. Defendant reserves the right to propose categorical logging or exclusion of categories not required to be logged, including post-commencement attorney-client communications or attorney work product, to the extent permitted by rule, order, or agreement.

edits.text: 4. SUPPLEMENTATION AND RESERVATION. Defendant further reserves all rights and objections regarding relevance, admissibility, authenticity, foundation, confidentiality, privilege, burden, proportionality, and the scope of discovery, provided that any objection limiting the scope of a response will be stated in response to the specific request at issue and will state whether materials are being withheld on that basis.
